{"idea":"Substitute the given values for v and z into the equation v = i * z, then solve for i by multiplying by the inverse of z. Verify the resulting complex expression with ring normalization.","proof":"rw [h₀, h₁, h₂] at h₀
have hz : (2 - Complex.I : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  norm_num
calc
  i = (1 + Complex.I) / (2 - Complex.I) := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hz).2
    simpa [h₀, h₁, h₂] using h₀.symm
  _ = 1 / 5 + 3 / 5 * Complex.I := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring","insight_statement":"","insight_proof":""}
